name: Early Click Buffer
description: Click a few milliseconds early and the input still lands on time. Works in every game mode, on orbs, at any TPS, and alongside Click Between Frames.

window-ms.name: Buffer window (ms)
window-ms.description: How early a click can be and still count. 17 ms is about 1 frame at 60 FPS, 33 ms about 2 frames. It is time-based, so it behaves the same at 60, 240 or any other TPS.

ground.name: Buffer ground / ceiling clicks
ground.description: Cube, ball, robot and spider landings.
